Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:
Hi,
Suppose I control a ready Victoria. I have the Edge, and 0 VP. The
Rising is in play.

If I use Victoria's special during my Master phase, will I gain pool?

Thanks,
Pascal

~~

The Rising
Cardtype: Event
Gehenna. Do not replace until your prey is ousted.
Requires at least two other Gehenna cards in play. A Methuselah cannot
gain pool during his or her own turn unless he or she has the Edge or
at least one victory point. Any pool he or she would gain goes to the
bank instead.

Victoria
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Malkavian
Group: 2
Capacity: 5
Discipline: cel obf AUS
Camarilla: During your master phase, you may burn the Edge to gain 2
pool if Victoria is ready

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On Mar 15, 8:13 am, floppyzedolfin <floppyzedol...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hi,
> Suppose I control a ready Victoria. I have the Edge, and 0 VP. The
> Rising is in play.
>
> If I use Victoria's special during my Master phase, will I gain pool?

No. You have to burn the Edge to gain the pool, so you won't have the
Edge any more.
